notes.title: Now with remastered levels!
notes.content:
Hello community!

So we have replaced all levels from 16 - 249 that contained solutions of the following forms:

[list]
    [*]x = x
    [*]x + y = z
    [*]x + y = z + w
[/list]

Also, the "Even" pack was replaced with a new pack, named "Two Digits Only". It contains levels with numbers 10 - 99.

So it is time to start playing Two Digits remastered edition!
